8.3.3 MAC Interface
A message authentication code (MAC) is a short piece of information used to authenti-
cate a message. A MAC algorithm accepts as input a secret key and an arbitrary-length
message to be authenticated, and outputs a MAC. The MAC value protects both a mes-
sage’s data integrity as well as its authenticity, by allowing verifiers (who also possess
the secret key) to detect any changes to the message content.
